Shoaib Akhtar regrets not playing under Imran Khan

Former Pakistan cricketer Shoaib Akhtar stated he regrets not playing under Imran Khan's captaincy. Akhtar believes he could have taken 400 Test wickets if Imran Khan had been captain during his career. Akhtar played 46 Test matches, taking 178 wickets, and his international career concluded during the 2011 World Cup in India. Reports at the time cited differences with captain Shahid Afridi as a reason for his exit.
